author: Eurogamer
text:
Here are our PS Plus monthly games for August, with a bonus pack for Marvel fans

August is nearly upon us, and to mark the occasion Sony has revealed the month's line-up of PlayStation Plus games. This month looks to be a banger, meaning PS Plus subscribers of any tier should have at least one great game to look forward to.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Dragon Quest announces new collaboration with Google's Gemini for in-person event in Tokyo after DQX's controversial AI-powered companion

Back in March, Square Enix announced that it was teaming up with Google Gemini for an AI-powered "Chatty Slimey" companion on Dragon Quest X, a Japan-exclusive MMORPG. Following a divisive reaction, another Gemini-powered Dragon Quest announcement is here.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Wizards of the Coast president steps down after only two years in the role

The president of Wizards of the Coast will be stepping down from the role after only two years in the job.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Rare Nintendo Famicombox units found in perfectly operational state in a Japanese "love hotel"

Today, in unexpected retro gaming news, we've learned about the discovery of the legendary Famicombox - Nintendo's commercial-use-only console released in 1986 - in a Japanese love hotel.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
The Legend of Zelda movie's Link, Benjamin Evan Ainsworth, couldn't play Breath of the Wild because of his age (and the lack of a Switch)

The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom expanded the mainline series' horizons and brought in plenty of new players, but the actor playing live-action Link missed the former - initially due to his age.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Marvel's Spider-Man 2 gets two new costumes inspired by Brand New Day and Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls

There's good news for all the web-swingers out there (no, not you lot, keep it down). Marvel's Spider-Man 2 has got a new update today, adding two new spider suits inspired by some big new releases.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Call of Duty: Black Ops 2 players want you to please stop voting for Nuketown, Hijacked and Raid every match

The recently released Call of Duty: Black Ops 1 and 2 PlayStation ports have been incredibly popular, but that influx of players also reminded everyone that - classics or not - players will simply keep choosing the same few maps every match.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Roblox game Be Dead Forever Simulator is likely dead forever

A beloved Roblox game - Be Dead Forever Simulator - has been made unavailable to download due to the platform's new age verification rules. It's looking very unlikely it'll ever be available ever again.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Ubisoft is letting owners of its Xbox games play select titles for free on PC as part of a new partnership with Microsoft

Microsoft has announced a new partnership with Ubisoft that'll let owners of select Ubisoft Xbox games play them on PC at no extra cost.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners was reportedly being turned into a 2.5D brawler by CD Projekt Red and Shantae studio WayForward, but its fate is uncertain

Cyberpunk 2077 continues to perform exceptionally well for CD Projekt Red, but as we wait for news on its (still faraway) sequel, it's been reported the studio had a smaller Cyberpunk 2077 game in the works at one time too.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Monster Hunter Wilds' latest patch makes online-only missions playable offline, alongside some other useful updates

Things have been quiet on the Monster Hunter Wilds front since the announcement of its major Ascendance expansion earlier in June. While the base game continues to receive updates, this next one makes one of its most interesting quest types - which previously required an online connection - available to play offline.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Dragon's Dogma 2 is getting a Fallout-inspired homesteading mod with fully customisable houses, and its creator has tons of big ideas for it

Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen is coming later this year, and before that, Capcom is releasing updates to address player complaints. But that doesn't mean modders are waiting for things to quiet down again before working on ambitious user-made expansions.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Pragmata and Resident Evil Requiem bolster a strong quarter for Capcom, as Monster Hunter and Street Fighter sales hit record highs

Capcom has released sales figures for two of its latest releases - Pragmata and Resident Evil Requiem - in the company's Q1 2026 financial report. Both are doing well.

Read more

author: Eurogamer
text:
Xbox CTO explains what caused the Xbox outage, apologises to players, and outlines what's being done going forward

On Monday, Xbox suffered a major server outage that affected players worldwide. The outage took down several key functions of Xbox, including the ability to buy and download games, play them offline, and even extended to disc-based games. Services have since been restored, but the sudden and severe nature of the outage required some explanation.
